welcome: [PS] Welcome to Afghan Support. Select a topic below or type your question.
title: [PS] CC-AZ Assistant
multiCandidate: [PS] I found a few things that might help. Which one were you looking for?
fallback: [PS] Thank you for your message. A caseworker will follow up with you within 1–2 business days. For immediate help, please call +1 (602) 666-6170.

immigration.label: [PS] Immigration Help
immigration.response: [PS] We provide immigration support services including case management, legal referrals, and document assistance for Afghan families in Phoenix. Our team can help you navigate the immigration process and connect you with trusted legal professionals.

community.label: [PS] Community Resources
community.response: [PS] Connect with local food banks, healthcare providers, housing assistance, and other essential services in the Phoenix area. We maintain a curated list of community partners ready to help Afghan families.

rights.label: [PS] Know Your Rights
rights.response: [PS] Learn about your rights as an immigrant, refugee, or asylum seeker. Access know-your-rights materials in Dari, Pashto, and English. This information is for educational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice.

events.label: [PS] Events
events.response: [PS] We host regular workshops, legal clinics, and cultural events for the Afghan community in Phoenix. Check our events page for upcoming dates and registration.

contact.label: [PS] Contact Info
contact.response: [PS] Reach our team by phone, email, or WhatsApp. Our office is located at 5151 N 19th Ave, Phoenix AZ 85015. We respond to all inquiries within 1–2 business days.

speak.label: [PS] Speak to Someone
speak.response: [PS] Our caseworkers are available to speak with you in Dari, Pashto, or English. Whether you need guidance, emotional support, or just someone to listen, we are here for you.
